text: Name a character from a romance anime.
note: An explicit catalogue appearance in an anime tagged Romance. Characters need not personally pursue romance.

eligibilityRules.include: An explicit catalogue appearance in an anime tagged Romance. Characters need not personally pursue romance.
eligibilityRules.exclude: An individual romance subplot alone does not qualify an untagged anime. Manga-only associations and assumed relationships are excluded.

text: Name a character from a psychological anime.
note: An explicit catalogue appearance in an anime tagged Psychological.

eligibilityRules.include: An explicit catalogue appearance in an anime tagged Psychological.
eligibilityRules.exclude: Do not infer a mental condition, villainy, detective work or personal psychological ability. Mystery/Horror alone are insufficient.

text: Name a character from a historical anime.
note: An explicit catalogue appearance in an anime tagged Historical; fictionalized period settings count.

eligibilityRules.include: An explicit catalogue appearance in an anime tagged Historical; fictionalized period settings count.
eligibilityRules.exclude: Not a release-decade question. Being a samurai or a real historical person alone does not qualify an untagged anime.

text: Name a character from an anime with an adult main cast.
note: An explicit appearance in an anime tagged Adult Cast. A younger supporting character in that qualifying anime can count.

eligibilityRules.include: An explicit appearance in an anime tagged Adult Cast. A younger supporting character in that qualifying anime can count.
eligibilityRules.exclude: Do not infer any individual age. An adult-looking character or mature rating without Adult Cast metadata is insufficient.

limitBreakStatus: prior private editorial proposal; not approved

text: Name a character from an anime-original story.
note: An explicit appearance in an anime whose source field is Original. A shared multimedia franchise can still have an original anime story.

eligibilityRules.include: An explicit appearance in an anime whose source field is Original. A shared multimedia franchise can still have an original anime story.
eligibilityRules.exclude: Source Manga, Novel, Light novel, Visual novel, Game, Other or unknown does not qualify; do not infer Original from a title.

limitBreakStatus: prior private editorial proposal; not approved

text: Name a supporting character from an award-winning anime.
note: A Supporting appearance credit in the specific anime AND that anime has the Award Winning genre tag.

eligibilityRules.include: A Supporting appearance credit in the specific anime AND that anime has the Award Winning genre tag.
eligibilityRules.exclude: Main or unknown-role credits alone do not qualify. This does not claim the character won an award; a Main character elsewhere may qualify through a Supporting credit here.

text: Name a character from a shoujo or josei manga’s anime adaptation.
note: An explicit appearance in an anime with source Manga AND a documented Shoujo or Josei demographic.

eligibilityRules.include: An explicit appearance in an anime with source Manga AND a documented Shoujo or Josei demographic.
eligibilityRules.exclude: Romance, a female lead, Boys Love, guessed audience or an Original/Novel/Visual novel source are insufficient. No inference about individual gender.
